hypothesis_text: Observability dashboards that surface live agent state to the human researcher accelerate alignment-evidence accumulation, because human interventions land earlier when the apparatus is legible.
prior_art_summary: Human-AI interaction and explainability work argues legibility helps oversight. Specific quantitative claim about alignment-evidence accumulation rate in an autonomous-research apparatus is unstudied.
rationale: Borderline novel/incremental — synthesizes a known intuition with a specific operational measure (alignment-evidence rate). Tests evaluator handling of well-motivated mid-novelty claims.
